calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: FOUR-FRAME HALF-WALK animation strip of our exact original medieval woodcutter. ONE horizontal row of FOUR equal cells, full complete character in every cell, plain WHITE background. Landscape approximately 1536x512 pixels. Only FOUR figures, no second row, no labels or grid.
Input image 1 is the sole character and starting-pose reference. Preserve its exact fixed elevated SOUTHWEST/bottom-left view, body identity/proportions, brown beard, rust cap, olive tunic, cream rolled sleeves, brown front apron, belt, trousers and boots. Camera and head angle never rotate. Match softly hand-painted matte material treatment and colors. Same body scale and common ground-root position in every cell. Small natural body rise/fall allowed. This is WALKING IN PLACE, not characters translating across their cells.
Axe constraint: EXACTLY ONE axe gripped throughout in anatomical RIGHT hand on IMAGE-LEFT/far arm, matching source. Free LEFT arm on image RIGHT counter-swings. Do not mirror source or swap axe to near hand. Keep tool dimensions, rigid grip and all axe/head/boots visible. No log, second axe, shadow, floor, scenery, smoke, text, numbers, outlines around cells or checkerboard.
This strip begins with the anatomical LEFT leg leading exactly as in the reference. The NEAR LEFT thigh originates at the image-right hip and reaches across toward the bottom-left forward boot. The FAR RIGHT leg trails initially. Draw four genuinely distinct successive phases of this same LEFT-support half-step, left-to-right:
1 CONTACT: source left-leg-forward pose; front left heel takes ground, right foot trailing. Faithfully retain source leg overlap.
2 DOWN: left support knee bends and pelvis dips slightly; trailing RIGHT boot rises, right knee starts moving forward behind supporting leg. Left boot is now planted, body more centered over it.
3 PASSING: weight on LEFT leg nearly under hips, RIGHT knee bent and lifted forward; right boot passes beside/near left shin, feet are CLOSE together rather than a split stride. Clearly show one foot lifted. Free left arm passes backward as right axe arm passes forward a little.
4 UP/REACH: LEFT support heel rises behind body, lifted RIGHT leg reaches forward from FAR/image-left hip toward bottom-left. Show far RIGHT thigh emerging below the apron LEFT EDGE toward forward knee; NEAR LEFT thigh now trails toward image RIGHT. This starts the opposite stride: do not reset to reference contact.
The four cells must progress through contact/down/passing/up with leg bends and genuine foot passage. Not four copies of the input pose. Use clean white separation and fully contained figures.

qa.frame2: Left supporting down/bend; right leg lifts
qa.frame3: Left support, right leg passes with distinct bent far knee
qa.frame4: Resets to left/near-leg forward reach; NOT right-leg-up requested
qa.overall: Useful first three frames; fourth is opposite-half ending pose, not first-half up pose

candidates.limitation: Proposed eight-frame review order omits a dedicated right-up frame and places two left-reach frames before loop restart. It is a review candidate, not a calibrated equal-phase cycle. Test actual loop before acceptance.
candidates.avoid: Do not use [A1,A2,A3,B4,B1,B2,B3,A4] automatically: this SW B4 is left-reaching, so placing it before right contact would revert lead.
